content_fields.title: Verify that UDDI/ebXML spoofing is prevented
content_fields.description: Verify that service registry spoofing is prevented.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means attempting to publish or alter a registry entry without authorization and confirming the attempt is refused, then confirming consumers reject an unverified endpoint.
content_fields.found: No service registry is present in the deployment.
content_fields.missing: The registry that would be the subject of the test.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification has no subject in this architecture.
content_fields.action: The architecture owners should record the countermeasure as not applicable unless service discovery is adopted.
